selection_rule: Highest silhouette among KMeans k=2..6; ties prefer smaller k. Ward is a diagnostic comparator.

feature_notes.reference_date_reason: Fixed near the last source enrollment date; avoids aging this historical snapshot to the execution year.
feature_notes.age: Approximate age: 2014 minus year of birth; exact birthday unavailable.
feature_notes.currency: Not specified by the dataset; no currency symbol is assumed.
feature_notes.shares: Within-family spending and purchase-channel shares; zero total means share zero.
feature_notes.income_missing: Median-imputed only in the fitted segmentation pipeline; profile income statistics use observed values.
feature_notes.target_exclusion: Response and AcceptedCmp variables are excluded from clustering and PCA.
feature_notes.demographics: Age, income and children at home influence distances; deployment would require checks on segment-specific offers and outcomes.

limitations: Scores describe structure within this historical snapshot, not generalization to future customers.
Silhouette is calculated on a fixed random sample of at most 1500 records; other scores use all records.
Seed stability tests initialization only, not population or time stability.
KMeans is chosen for assignable operational segments; higher Ward silhouette, if present, must be disclosed.
Three clusters remain an exploratory alternative; extra marketing value requires a campaign experiment.
Spending and channel shares can overlap in information with totals; segment sensitivity to features remains a deployment check.

stability.scope: Initialization stability on the same customer snapshot; not resampling stability.
Initialization stability on the same customer snapshot; not resampling stability.

pca.role: Descriptive visualization and dimensionality diagnostic; neither clustering nor the classifier is fitted on these two PCs.
pca.loadings_definition: PCA component coefficients (unit-length directions), not feature-outcome associations.
